concept: Rows of things of one kind; an inset list is a level-2 pane with hairlines that start where the text starts.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a List with a border around every row and a grey zebra stripe
default_to_avoid.kind: list, list group, settings list, rows
default_to_avoid.why_not: borders and stripes on every row draw more lines than content; Pane uses one pane with hairlines from the text column

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the inset list is one level-2 pane and its rows add no second blur or pane

derivation.consequence: padding inside a pane is larger than the gap between items in it, so the edge reads as the object's boundary
derivation.form: hairlines start at the text column, so the leading column reads as one band down the list

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: a row that leads somewhere is pressed as a whole and keeps a 44px height

options: A inset pane, hairlines from the text
variants.picked: A inset pane, hairlines from the text
variants.reason: A is one pane with quiet hairlines (P3). B draws a box per row. C adds a grey that owns nothing.

root.why: the rows stack as a real list so their count is announced and read

inset.why: the inset list is a level-2 pane with its own edge, like a group of settings

plain.why: the plain list sits straight on the pane it is in, inside a card

item.why: each item holds its row and draws the hairline under it when inset

row.why: each row keeps at least a 44px height with the leading, text and trailing parts in a line

press.why: a pressable row lights under the pointer like a menu row and shows the focus ring inside

leading.why: the leading part holds an avatar or an icon at a fixed size so text lines up

text.why: the title and the second line stack and take the free width of the row

title.why: the title is the body size in the primary tone and wraps instead of spilling

description.why: the second line is secondary at label size, a date or a count

trailing.why: the trailing part holds a value or a control at the end in the secondary tone

chevron.why: a chevron says the row opens a page of its own and flips in RTL

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and the fill so the parts stay findable

hover.why: a pressable row takes the quiet surface under the pointer to show what will be pressed

focus-visible.why: the focus ring is drawn inside the row so it is not clipped by the pane

background-color.why: the hover surface fades in on the hover ease instead of flashing
